title: Rate-induced tipping in a coral reef ecosystem: A slow increase in fishing effort can induce reef collapse
summary: Critical transitions describe sudden changes in the state of an ecosystem. In classical bifurcation theory, such transitions occur when the value of a parameter exceeds a threshold (``bifurcation") value. More recently, critical transitions which are triggered by the rate of change of a parameter were described by Wieczorek et al. [Wieczorek, S., Ashwin, P., Luke, C.M., Cox, P.M., Proceedings of the Royal Society A 467(2129), 1243-1269, 2011].
